description: This file is a server-side route module in a SvelteKit project that handles data fetching, processing, and actions related to 'cases' in a CRM application. It manages API requests to the Django backend to load case data, handle filtering, pagination, and perform CRUD operations and comments on cases.

methods.name: load
methods.description: Fetches case data, handles filters, pagination, and transforms data for frontend display.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Handles creation of a new case via API.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Updates existing case details via API.

methods.name: comment
methods.description: Creates a new comment on a case.

methods.name: moveCase
methods.description: Moves a case within the list or changes its status/stage.
